title: Colgante Pounamu Maori: Transformación Cinematográfica Épica de Fantasía de Artefacto Tradicional de Piedra Verde
prompt: A cinematic reinterpretation of traditional Maori pounamu (greenstone) pendant as an ancient mythical artifact, carved from stone and gold, covered in glowing runes and signs of age. Soft god-rays break through mist, dramatic shadows, epic fantasy realism, ultra-detailed textures.
